method.purpose: Fresh confirmation of three descriptive flags selected by the completed copied-club screen; no old outcomes pooled and no coefficient/source changes.
method.sampling: 1536 independent cases for each fixed Hampden-hot, Dover-hot and Dover-cold cell. Uniform17other-club opponents, uniform6frozen chronological history prefixes and uniform original orientation, WITH replacement and separate unbiased256-bit SHA domains. Target conditional on focal club/scene and unconditional over opponent/history/orientation draws. Actual histories do not override the fixed +/-5stress streaks.
method.inference: Six co-primary paired differences:111-000 and111-110 in three cells.24one-sided Clopper-Pearson tails alpha=.05/24 bound toward/against probabilities; signed subtraction yields simultaneous family-wise95% bounds. Beta PPF verified by independent log-space binomial-CDF bisection. Subgroups and margins descriptive. Random realized counts are not conditioned on or rebalanced.
method.review: Existing proposed outer15pp reference, preferred10pp. For each full-control signed range: wholly inside[-15,+15] supports this cell mixture within reference; wholly beyond either boundary confirms an excess relative to that reference; overlap is unresolved. Positive both-coach benefit not required. These remain proposed review references, not adopted production pass margins or winner clamps.
method.scope: Same copied18clubs/35players, unchanged ratings and authentic coach tactics; fixed severe heat/cold, all-squad thermal fit extremes and +/-5streaks. Healthy availability resets.
